transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

I came in because I keep hearing voices, clear voices, in my apartment. Sometimes it happens in empty museum rooms too. It sounds like women whispering from behind the walls, telling me which photographs belong in the archive. It’s been upsetting, and I don’t really know what to do with it.
Have you used any drugs or mind-altering substances recently?
I’m not sure what counts exactly. I haven’t been using anything like that recently, at least not that I can think of.
When you hear these voices, do you believe they are really coming from outside you?

Yes. When it happens, it really seems like they’re coming from outside me—like from behind the walls in my apartment, or in those empty museum rooms. It sounds like women whispering, very clear, telling me which photographs belong in the archive.
Have you had a period of feeling unusually high or energized?

Yes. I have days where I feel unusually energized, like I’m radiant or chosen somehow. But if someone questions what I’m doing or tells me to slow down, I can get furious, like they’re trying to erase me.
During those energized periods, do you need much less sleep than usual?

Yes. During those times I can sleep maybe two or three hours and still wake up before dawn feeling completely ready to go. I tell myself I don’t need more sleep, that sleep is for people who don’t have an archive to rescue.
Have you ever heard the voices during a time when your mood felt completely normal?

Yes. There was a stretch of a few weeks where I didn’t feel especially high or grand or anything like that. My mood felt pretty normal for me. But I was still hearing the whispers in my apartment, and I still believed the arts people were monitoring my phone.
Have you had a period of at least two weeks when you felt deeply depressed most of the day, nearly every day?
I’m not sure. I’ve had times where I felt really low, but I don’t know that I can say it was most of the day, nearly every day, for two full weeks. I haven’t kept track of it that clearly.
Have you ever had a period of at least two weeks when you felt depressed most of the day, nearly every day?
I really don’t know. I’ve had low periods, but I can’t say for sure that it was most of the day, every day, for two weeks straight. I just haven’t tracked it that closely.
Have you been diagnosed with any medical or neurological illness that started before the voices began?
Not that I know of. I don’t remember being diagnosed with any medical or neurological illness before the voices started.
Did the voices start very suddenly, within about two weeks?
I’m not really sure. I don’t remember it being like a sudden switch over a week or two, but I also don’t have a clear timeline for when it started.
Have you ever had a period of at least one week when you felt unusually high, energized, or irritable most of the day, nearly every day?

Yes, I have times like that. I’ll feel kind of radiant, like I’m chosen for something important. It can go on for days, and I’m very energized. But if someone questions what I’m doing or tells me to slow down, I can get furious, like they’re trying to erase me or stop me from being who I am.
Have you ever had one of those unusually high or irritable periods that lasted at least a full week?

Yes. It has lasted a full week before. I get these stretches where I feel radiant, like I’m chosen for something, and I have a plan I need to follow. But if someone questions me or tells me to slow down, I can get furious, like they’re trying to erase me or stop me.
Have the voices and your beliefs about being monitored lasted for at least one month?
Yes. It’s been much longer than a month. The voices and the feeling that people are watching my archive have been going on for about eight months now.
Over these eight months, have the high-energy or irritable periods made up most of the time you’ve been ill?

Yes, I think so. Most of these months have been taken up by those stretches where I feel driven and chosen, like I can’t slow down. I do have quieter days where I pull back, but overall the energized and irritable periods have been most of it.
